worldcombat.skill.headsmash.summary: An all-or-nothing headlong headbutt: charge in a straight line and hurl the target with your whole head. A hit reflects a fraction of the damage onto you; a miss plants you face-first into the ground. You trade your own life for theirs.
The headbutt deals %1$s contact damage, charging up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block collision radius.
On a hit the user takes %1$s of the actual damage as recoil and hurls the target up to %3$s blocks along the charge; a miss costs %2$s of the user's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.headsmash.hold.on: Steady form: power, recoil, crash damage and knockback all step down, and the wind-up, recovery and cooldown are shorter - safer for a long fight.
worldcombat.skill.headsmash.hold.off: All-in form: power and recoil are maxed out and a whiff hurts more - for the finishing blow.
worldcombat.skill.headsmash.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, costing %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.headsmash.growth.0: From level %1$s the headbutt power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.headsmash.growth.1: From level %1$s the headbutt power rises to %2$s and the recoil fraction to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.headsmash.use.0: Finish a low-health target with one absurdly heavy headbutt
worldcombat.skill.headsmash.use.1: Trade for the heaviest single-target damage when survival is not in question
worldcombat.skill.headsmash.use.2: Hurl the target away to open space for allies
worldcombat.skill.headsmash.preference.h: On: power, recoil, crash damage and knockback all step down, and the wind-up, recovery and cooldown are shorter - safer for a long fight. Off: the all-in form maxes out power and recoil, for the finishing blow.
worldcombat.skill.headsmash.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts headbutts sooner, and is easier to crash far away.
Below this health fraction the user stops starting headbutts (unless the target is nearly down). Higher is more protective, and grabs fewer kills.
This is a straight-line charge along the aim direction that resolves only the first enemy it touches; running out of distance, being blocked, or being unable to advance all count as a miss.
